pages.text: $(l)For Essentia processing$(), use the emptying essentia interface (not AE2 buses); then you don't need pipes.
$(l)Gene farming scales efficiently$() with Gendustry’s dedicated gene duplicator machine.

$(l)Alverary drone production$() is optimized with an Oblivion frame (only one needed); route outputs back in with high-priority conduits, send drones to a gene extractor, and filter to keep only Rainbow genes.
$(l)Chaos Condensers$(): four are typically sufficient; add more only if output is insufficient.
